newsitem.title: USA: IMF warns Belize on dollar peg, urges budget steps.
newsitem.headline: IMF warns Belize on dollar peg, urges budget steps.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund's board warned Belize that its currency peg with the U.S. dollar was at risk if it fails to tighten its budget.

"Directors were of the view that the sustainability of the exchange rate peg depended crucially on the strengthening of the fiscal position, and on wage restraint," the IMF said in a summary of the board's mid-May economic assessment of Belize.
The Fund also warned the former British colony that it could not continue to depend on exceptional foreign assistance -- as it did last year -- to plug its external financing gap.

The IMF conducts annual assessments of all its member nations under Article Four of its Articles of Agreement. Under a new policy, countries that wish to can have the main points of the discussion published.
